notes.title: Development Update: New Character Portrait Breathing Effect & Letter System
notes.content:
[p]Greetings, fellow cultivators! It's been a while.[/p][p]Recently, we’ve added two new features to the game:[/p][list][*][p]A breathing animation effect for character portraits[/p][/*][*][p]A letter system[/p][/*][/list][p]Our character portraits have gone through three iterations, and we’ve now finalized the current art style and presentation.
Due to limited team resources, the customization options for appearances are still somewhat limited, but we will continue to optimize and expand them in future updates.[/p][p]The letter system is an important complement to the talisman system.
While talismans require both parties to exchange spiritual seals to communicate, letters support one-way sending, improving communication efficiency between cultivators.[/p][p]For more details, please watch the video. (To prioritize the core gameplay experience, the video may not include your language. We will make efforts to provide more language versions in future updates—thank you for your understanding.)[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="QIeROr1rOJQ;full"][/previewyoutube][p]We sincerely thank all our supporters.
Your encouragement is the greatest motivation that keeps us going![/p]
